basic_info.description: This is it, YOUR NEW HOME! Welcome to this beautifully updated home with ocean views in the highly desirable Merced Heights neighborhood of San Francisco. Boasting numerous high-end upgrades and immaculate attention to detail throughout, this amazing property features brand new interior and exterior designer paint, brand new roof with permit, gorgeous vinyl plank flooring, addition of one bedroom and one bathroom with permit, all new recessed lighting throughout, stylishly renovated bathrooms, and a truly exquisite kitchen with custom quartz countertops, modern cabinets, and top-of-the-line appliances. Outside, enjoy the incredible backyard, beautifully designed and easily maintained, perfect for relaxation or entertaining guests. Technical upgrades include all new electricals, new copper plumbing, new tankless water heater and HVAC, brand new double pane windows, Hansgrohe fixtures, new rear fencing and redwood decks, and smart ring doorbell and thermostat. Whatever your lifestyle, Merced Heights' ideal location and distinctive community lets you create a life uniquely you, and this beautiful modern home will have you and your family living the good life for years to come. WELCOME TO YOUR NEW HOME!
